applicabilityBasis.summary: STUSD represents transferable liquidity over locked StoneYield sUSDC strategy positions. The current token page describes a one-to-one wrapper and PancakeSwap market exits; published issuer code provides wrapping and administrative reserve transfers without a holder unwrap function. The reviewed materials do not establish an issuer obligation to redeem STUSD for fixed national-currency monetary value.

genius.notes: Reviewed as a managed strategy-position wrapper independently from underlying USDC. Current website and public contract sources describe transferable STUSD over locked sUSDC; other public documentation reverses these roles. Public repository code is product-design evidence and was not matched to current deployed bytecode. Exact legal token issuer is unresolved, so issuerEntity and licensing fields are omitted. One-to-one token accounting and AMM swaps do not establish direct fiat redemption. No Circle authorization, issuer intent or monthly attestation is inherited. No securities-law classification or exemption from other financial-services law is asserted.
